Exchange/platform: KuCoin
Headline: ChartControl AI x KuCoin Special Trading Competition Is Live!
Prize pool: 10K USDT
Start: 2026-11-15T16:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-15T15:59:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 550 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 50 USDT (deposit)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Thank you for trading with KuCoin. We're excited to announce that we have deepened our partnership with ChartControl AI!
To celebrate this collaboration, we are launching an exclusive trading competition with a dynamic prize pool of up to 10,000 USDT. The final rewards will be unlocked based on the total trading volume generated by all registered participants during the campaign.
The more the community trades together, the bigger the rewards unlocked for everyone.
In addition to the trading competition, both new and existing users can enjoy more bonuses during the campaign period. Don't miss this opportunity to trade and earn more with ChartControl AI and KuCoin.
Join Now!
## Event Details
Event Period: From 00:00 on November 16, 2026 to 23:59 December 15, 2026 (UTC+8)
## Eligible Users
Users registered via ChartControl AI's Broker referral code or using the terminal of ChartControl AI
## Event Rule
## Trading Competition — Prize Pool Up to 10,000 USDT
To qualify for the leaderboard, participants must achieve a minimum eligible trading volume of 100,000 USDT during the campaign period.
The final prize pool will be determined based on the total eligible trading volume generated by all registered participants.
## Stage 1 — Basic Prize Pool (3,000 USDT)
If the total eligible trading volume of all registered participants does not exceed 10,000,000 USDT, a 3,000 USDT prize pool will be unlocked.
## Top 1–30 users on the leaderboard will each receive:
100 USDT Futures Trial Funds
## Stage 2 — Full Prize Pool (10,000 USDT)
If the total eligible trading volume of all registered participants exceeds 10,000,000 USDT, the full 10,000 USDT prize pool will be unlocked.
## Top 30 Rewards:
1st Place: 2,000 USDT Futures Trial Funds
2nd Place: 1,400 USDT Futures Trial Funds
3rd Place: 800 USDT Futures Trial Funds
4th–10th Place: 400 USDT Futures Trial Funds each
11th–30th Place: 150 USDT Futures Trial Funds each
The higher your trading volume, the higher your ranking and rewards.
## More benefits for ChartControl AI users
General Cashback: All eligible users will enjoy 5% commission-sharing on trades during the event
- Exclusive New User Rewards: Up to 550 USDT welcome gifts per user
New users who register for a KuCoin account using ChartControl AI's broker referral code (R-code) and complete the following tasks can unlock exclusive rewards.
## One-Time Deposit Bonus:
New users who register, complete KYC within 14 days, and deposit at least 50 USDT can earn:
- Spot trading fee deduction coupon worth 50 USDT + Futures trading fee deduction coupon worth 50 USDT
## One-Time Tiered Trade Bonus:
New users who register, complete KYC and deposit within 14 days, and reach the following Spot + Futures trading volumes can unlock corresponding rewards:
- Trading volume ≥ 1,000 USDT: Interest-Free Coupon worth 50 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 5,000 USDT: VIP3 benefits voucher
- Trading volume ≥ 10,000 USDT: Futures trading fee deduction coupon worth 200 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 40,000 USDT: Futures trial fund worth 50 USDT
- Trading volume ≥ 100,000 USDT: Futures trial fund worth 150 USDT
## Note:
1. The full 10,000 USDT prize pool will be unlocked only if the total event trading volume exceeds 10,000,000 USDT.
2. Only users with an eligible trading volume of at least 100,000 USDT will qualify for the leaderboard.
3. Rankings will be determined based on each participant's eligible trading volume.
4. The top 30 on the leaderboard who meet the eligibility requirements will be rewarded.
5. Final reward distribution depends on the prize pool unlock stage achieved during the event.
Learn more abount the campaign.
## About ChartControl AI
ChartControl AI is a web-based charting and AI-assisted trading terminal for crypto: real-time chart analysis, 100+ indicators, custom strategies and signals you can build with AI, auto-trading bots, a market scanner and trade reviews.

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Lead U.S. stock trades and earn rewards. New and experienced stock traders can get started with no followers required and earn 100 USDT, plus compensation covering 50% of losses on their first trade. Complete advanced tasks to earn additional rewards, with up to 520 USDT per user from a total prize pool of 26,000 USDT.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 17, 2026, 06:00 – December 14, 2026, 06:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: Earn Up to 200 USDT with Stock Lead Trading
During the event, start Stock Lead Trading for the first time and reach a Lead Trading volume of at least 100 USDT to earn 100 USDT. Available to the first 30 eligible users.
During the event, if your first stock lead trade incurs a loss, you can receive compensation covering 50% of the actual loss, up to 100 USDT. Limited to 30 users, selected by the trading volume of their first lead trade, from highest to lowest.
## Event 2: Complete Stock Lead Trading Tasks to Share a 20,000 USDT Prize Pool
Complete Stock Lead Trading tasks during the event to earn the corresponding rewards. Rewards can be combined, with a total task reward pool of 18,000 USDT.
Lead Trading Task | Reward (USDT)
Lead Trading Volume ≥ 5,000 | 50
Number of Copiers ≥ 5 | 50
Trading Days ≥ 3 | 50
Copy Trading Volume ≥ 100,000 | 150
Bonus Draw: Reach a Stock Lead Trading volume of at least 500 USDT to qualify. A total of 100 users will be selected at random to receive 20 USDT each from a 2,000 USDT prize pool.
## Important Notes
To qualify for rewards, select [Join Now] on this event page to register and complete identity verification.
In Event 1, the "Welcome Bonus" is awarded in the order in which users become stock lead traders. "First-Trade Loss Compensation" is awarded based on the trading volume of each user's first lead trade, from highest to lowest.
If the total rewards due to eligible users in Event 2 exceed the prize pool, rewards will be allocated by Lead Trading volume, from highest to lowest, until the pool is exhausted.
Event rewards will be distributed as Stock Bonus and credited to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends. Please check your Direct Messages for notifications.
Market makers, companies, and institutions are not eligible to participate in this event.
Bulk account registration, malicious volume manipulation, self-trading, wash trading, and other forms of cheating are strictly prohibited. Multiple accounts belonging to the same verified user will be treated as a single account.
If there is any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version prevails.
Due to changes in market conditions, fraud risks, and other factors, Gate reserves the right to make the final interpretation of this event. If you have any questions, please contact customer support.

Headline: Trenches BSC Chain Peak Trading Competition: Share 60,000 USDT in Airdrops, Champion Wins Up to 10,0...
Prize pool: 60K USDT
Start: 2026-11-17T08:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-23T08:00:00Z
Smallest threshold (parsed): 1000 USDT (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Choose from trending BSC chain tokens and trade to earn rewards. The Gate Trenches Peak Trading Competition is now live. During the event, register and trade BSC chain tokens in Gate Trenches to hit trading volume targets and jointly unlock an airdrop prize pool worth up to 50,000 USDT. The champion can win an airdrop worth up to 10,000 USDT, plus an additional 10,000 USDT all-user pool to share.
Please click "Join Now" on the event page to register before trading. Only eligible trades made in Gate Trenches during the event after successful registration will be counted.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 17, 2026, 08:00 – November 23, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Event Scope
All tokens in Gate Trenches on the BSC chain.
## Reward 1: All-User Rewards, Trade 1,000 USDT to Share a 10,000 USDT Airdrop Pool
During the event, when the total eligible trading volume (buy + sell) of all registered users in Gate Trenches on the BSC chain reaches 2,000,000 USDT, an airdrop sharing pool worth 10,000 USDT will be unlocked. This pool is independent of the tiered prize pools and is only available to users who did not receive any individual leaderboard ranking rewards.
Registered users who achieve a personal cumulative eligible trading volume (buy + sell) of at least 1,000 USDT during the event and did not receive any individual leaderboard ranking rewards are eligible to participate in the sharing. Individual rewards are calculated based on each user’s eligible trading volume as a proportion of the total eligible trading volume of all qualifying users, with a per-user cap of 5 USDT.
## Reward 2: BSC Chain Sprint, Unlock a Prize Pool Worth Up to 50,000 USDT
During the event, the eligible trading volume (buy + sell) of all registered users in Gate Trenches on the BSC chain will be accumulated collectively. Once the total trading volume reaches the corresponding threshold in the table below, the corresponding prize pool tier will be unlocked, with a maximum value of 50,000 USDT.
Total Event Trading Volume (Buy + Sell) | Unlocked Prize Pool Value
≥250,000 USDT | 1,000 USDT
≥500,000 USDT | 2,000 USDT
≥2,000,000 USDT | 5,000 USDT
≥3,500,000 USDT | 7,500 USDT
≥4,500,000 USDT | 10,000 USDT
≥6,000,000 USDT | 12,500 USDT
≥7,500,000 USDT | 15,000 USDT
≥9,000,000 USDT | 20,000 USDT
≥18,750,000 USDT | 50,000 USDT
The final prize pool is based on the highest tier reached by total eligible trading volume at the end of the event. Prize pool tiers are not cumulative. All registered users jointly unlock the prize pool. Individual rewards are allocated based on the final unlocked pool and each user's winning rank, not in proportion to their share of the total trading volume.
## Individual Leaderboard: Champion Airdrop Worth Up to 10,000 USDT
During the event, users who successfully register and trade tokens in Gate Trenches on the BSC chain can compete on the leaderboard once their individual cumulative eligible trading volume (buy + sell) reaches 40,000 USDT. Users who finish in the top 100 and meet the applicable claim requirements will receive rewards based on the percentages in the table below.
Users ranking in the top 3 must also reach an individual cumulative eligible trading volume of 150,000 USDT to claim their respective ranking rewards.
Final Ranking | Prize Pool Allocation (%) per Winner | Example: Total Prize Pool of 5,000 USDT | Example: Total Prize Pool of 20,000 USDT | Example: Total Prize Pool of 50,000 USDT
1st | 20.00% | 1,000 USDT | 4,000 USDT | 10,000 USDT
2nd | 10.00% | 500 USDT | 2,000 USDT | 5,000 USDT
3rd | 8.00% | 400 USDT | 1,600 USDT | 4,000 USDT
4th–10th (Each) | 2.43% | 121.50 USDT | 486 USDT | 1,215 USDT
11th–100th (Each) | 0.50% | 25 USDT | 100 USDT | 250 USDT
The amounts in the table are sample rewards for the corresponding prize pool tier. Actual rewards are calculated based on the final unlocked prize pool at the end of the event and the user's winning rank. For example, if the final unlocked prize pool is worth 20,000 USDT, the champion reward is 4,000 USDT; if it is worth 50,000 USDT, the champion reward is 10,000 USDT.
Meeting the individual trading volume threshold does not guarantee a reward. Users must also meet the final ranking and the applicable reward claim requirements. Airdrops are distributed as Trenches token mystery boxes. USDT amounts represent the value of the rewards and are not paid out as equivalent amounts of USDT.
## Event Data and Reward Details
Trading Volume Updates Periodically: Individual cumulative trading volume is updated hourly. Data on the event page is for reference only. Page updates may take 1–2 hours. Final results will be based on the calculations performed after the event ends.
Instant Eligibility & Risk Screening: Click "Join Now" and complete registration to be confirmed as eligible to participate. Meet the required trading volume, prize-winning rank, and other claim requirements to receive rewards according to the rules.
Reward Slots Reassigned in Rank Order: Users who fail to meet the corresponding claim requirements or are disqualified will not receive the corresponding rewards. The slots will be reassigned to subsequent users who meet the corresponding claim requirements, based on their ranking by eligible cumulative trading volume. Users reassigned into the top 3 must still have individual eligible cumulative trading volume of at least 150,000 USDT.
## Notes
Users must complete identity verification before claiming rewards.
Only eligible trades made by users in Gate Trenches during the event after registration are counted. Trading volume is calculated as the combined buy and sell amounts.
The final prize pool is determined by the highest tier reached by the total eligible trading volume of all registered users. Prize pools for different tiers are not cumulative. Individual rewards require both the final winning rank and the corresponding claim requirements to be met. Reward slots will be reassigned to the next eligible users in rank order, in accordance with the rules above.
Event page data and estimated reward values are for reference only. Final results are subject to the calculations and distributions made after the event ends.
Rewards from this event cannot be combined with rewards from other events, and rewards from events of the same type cannot be stacked.
Airdrops are distributed as Trenches token mystery boxes. USDT amounts represent the value of the rewards and are not paid out as equivalent amounts of USDT. Token prices may fluctuate; rewards are based on the actual amount credited.
Rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the event ends.
Before trading, verify the token contract address and its chain. Coin information is contributed by the community; if you find any errors, please contact customer support.
When users first access Gate Trenches, they must follow the instructions to complete the Trading Disclaimer quiz and sign the User Agreement. Tokens in the zone may involve significant risks and volatility. Please fully understand the risks before participating.
Do not participate through cheating methods such as bulk account registration, malicious trading, self-trading, or coordinated trading. Multiple accounts under the same verified user will be treated as one account.
In the event of any discrepancies between language versions, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the right of final interpretation for this event and may modify the applicable terms or cancel the event without prior notice.
Users in the UK and other restricted regions may be unable to use all or some services, including participation in this event. See the User Agreement for specific restrictions. This event is not intended to solicit or market to users in restricted regions.

Dear Biconomy Users,
The XTP Trading Competition is here!

2. Register for the campaign: Join Now
3. Trade XTP_USDT during the event period

## Ranking Calculation
- Ranking is based on total eligible XTP/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled or unfilled orders are excluded.
- Tie-breaker: If two or more users have the same eligible trading volume, the user who reaches that volume first will rank higher.
## Eligibility
- Minimum cumulative XTP/USDT trading volume: 500 USDT
- Complete at least 10 filled XTP/USDT trades during the campaign.

## 🎁 Prize Distribution (2,494,000 XTP):
RANKING | PRIZE | Minimum Trading Volume

🥈 2nd Place | 280,000 XTP | 8,000 USDT

4th-10th Place | Share 700,000 XTP by Trading Volume | 3,000 USDT
11th – 30th Place | Share 994,000 XTP by Trading Volume | 500 USDT
Qualified users will share 2,494,000 XTP based on their trading volume rankings.
